messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered PD-INC-7432 - cuda_alloc_failure on gpu-pool-eu-west-3 (host=gpu-12b3). Severity=P1. cuda_alloc_fail_rate=12.3/min. auto_escalate=true. link=https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-INC-7432

pagerduty: Alert routed to on-call: @jordan_sre (ack required)

jordan_sre: acked, taking this. seeing rapid OOM spikes across pool; several ml-serving pods in CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled. Affected models: redwood-small-v1 (quantized), open-llm-2.
Impact: endpoint latency up to 2.4s, 5xx rate increased ~8% for eu-west-3 hosted endpoints. Customers with traffic in eu-west-3: Searchly (prod), Playlistify (canary).

lia_engineer: noted - contacting Searchly now, opening support ticket. tagging SEs and listing mitigation options. :eyes:

devops-bot: Autoscaler attempts: added 3 nodes but provisioning failing: driver-mismatch error. kube events: "FailedMount" + "GPU driver version mismatch: installed=525, required>=535".

jordan_sre: quick triage logs from gpu host (shortened):
```
kubectl describe pod ml-serving-abcde -n infra-services
Status: CrashLoopBackOff
Containers:
  model-server:
    Last State: Terminated
    Reason: OOMKilled
    Exit Code: 137
Events:
  12m Warning Unhealthy Liveness probe failed
  11m Warning BackOff restarting container
kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 12345 (python) total-vm:1023456kB, anon-rss:980000kB
```

jordan_sre: plan (quick):
1) Reroute new requests for redwood-small-v1 away from eu-west-3 to eu-west-1 to stop additional pressure.
2) Bump kvcache.eviction_threshold on pool to 0.6 to free prefix/KV aggressively.
3) Drain and restart affected nodes after driver hotpatch; if provisioning fails, fallback to manual scale-up.
4) Notify customers and offer model-fallback option (smaller model or CPU fallback).

ops_lead: escalating—if reroute not effective within 5m escalate to infra oncall (maria_infra). tagging ops. :rotating_light:

jordan_sre: running routing change now:
```
# move traffic 100% for model redwood-small-v1 from eu-west-3 -> eu-west-1
rdwctl route set --model redwood-small-v1 --from eu-west-3 --to eu-west-1 --weight 100 --reason "OOM pressure eu-west-3"
```
Command output: routing update accepted, propagation pending (~30s).

pagerduty: PD-INC-7432 escalated to ops_lead per policy (no ack from infra within 5m).

support_agent: Searchly contacted (ticket #SUP-9923). They report ~12% error increase; want fallback to smaller model if possible. Playlistify on canary also seeing errors but lower volume. I'll offer toggle to smaller model and share ETA.

jordan_sre: increased kvcache eviction threshold:
```
rdwctl config set pool gpu-pool-eu-west-3 kvcache.eviction_threshold=0.6
Applied change; immediate effect on new allocations.
```
Started draining gpu-12b3 and gpu-12b4 (suspected hot nodes).

devops-bot: Driver hotpatch available -> applying to node group gpu-pool-eu-west-3. Hotpatch rollout started; node gpu-12b3 reboots with driver 535 successfully. Node reports Ready.

jordan_sre: routing propagation shows 100% traffic now on eu-west-1 for redwood-small-v1. Monitoring metrics: latency trending down, 5xx count decreasing.

support_agent: Searchly confirms errors dropping after reroute; accepts smaller-model fallback for additional safety. Playlistify sees lower error rate. Notifying both customers we'll keep them updated for 30m.

ops_lead: good work. keeping incident open for observation; if stable for 30m we de-escalate. prepping post-incident notes. handing off to night oncall at 1769991300 -> @ops_night.

jordan_sre: handing off monitoring to @ops_night. leaving runbook steps in thread and pinned snippet: reroute rollback command, config rollback commands, node drain/uncordon commands.

devops-bot: All nodes in pool now report GPU driver=535, Ready, and eviction metrics normalized.

lia_engineer: customer follow-ups logged, Searchly support ticket updated. Will add incident tags and impact summary for postmortem.

jordan_sre: closing active remediation. Will wait for 30m stable window then mark resolved. If any regression, reopen PD-INC-7432. :white_check_mark:
